How we keep it honest

Anyone can post online.
Not here.

Every experience goes through four stages before another buyer sees it. Our lens checks each one.

  1. 01
    Proof first

    A report needs the transfer receipt or the chat, plus the amount and the date.

    No proof, no report
  2. 02
    A person checks it

    We compare the proof with the story. Nothing goes live on its own.

    Read by a human
  3. 03
    Vendors get a say

    Any vendor can reply for free, with their own proof, right under the report.

    Free reply
  4. 04
    Live, carefully

    Your name is never shown and numbers are masked. False reports come down.

    Name never shown

    How it works

    How Confam works

    Confam is where buyers check a business before paying, and share what happened after. Every experience is checked by a person before anyone sees it.

    1

    Check a business

    Type their account number, phone or @handle. You see good experiences, problems other buyers reported, and the vendor’s replies, with dates.

    2

    Share your experience

    Went well? Say so, it helps good vendors get found. Went wrong? Report it with proof: the transfer receipt or the chat, the amount and the date.

    3

    We check before it shows

    A person compares the proof with the story. Nothing goes live on its own. Vendors can reply for free, right under any report.

    What we never do

    We never call anyone a scammer and never say anyone is safe. We never show your name, your contact or your proof. We never charge vendors to reply.

    Questions people ask

    1. Is it free?Yes, for buyers and vendors.
    2. Will the vendor know it was me?No. Your name and contact are never shown.
    3. Can a vendor delete a report?No. They can reply with their side and their proof.
    4. What if someone lies about me?Reports need proof and are checked first. Reply on the vendor page and send us your proof.
    Check a businessShare an experience

    Share your experience

    How did it go with this vendor?

    Tell the next buyer what happened, good or bad. A person reads every review before it shows. The vendor is never told who wrote it.

    How was it?
    1. Add proof: the transfer receipt or the chat
    Good proof
    • The transfer receipt from your bank app
    • The chat where you agreed the price
    • A photo of what arrived, if it was wrong
    Before you upload
    • Cover other people’s numbers and faces
    • Keep the date and amount visible
    • PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB

    Your proof stays private. Only the Confam team sees it, to check your story. It is never published. Before you upload, cover other people’s phone numbers, account numbers and faces.

    3. What happened?

    Review received

    Thank you. A person reads every review before it shows. Your name is never shown, and the middle of any account number is hidden. If you lost money, call your bank now and ask them to flag the transfer.

    Check someone

    What happens next

    1. A person reads itNothing goes public until someone on our team has looked at the proof.
    2. Details are hiddenWe blur your name, your number and the middle of any account number.
    3. It helps the next buyerApproved reports show in results next to what other people posted.

    Review rules

    1. Your own experienceSomething you bought or tried to buy in the last 12 months.
    2. No paid or swapped reviewsNot from the owner, staff, family or a competitor.
    3. No personal detailsLeave out names, phone numbers and photos of people.

    Lost money just now?

    Call your bank first and ask them to flag the transfer. The sooner they hear, the better your chance.

    For vendors

    Someone posted about your business?

    You can answer. Your reply shows right under the post, in your own words. It is free, and it always will be.

    Say what happened and what you did about it. Up to 600 characters.

    Reply received

    Thank you. We check that you run the business using the contact you gave, then your reply shows under every report about you.

    How your reply shows

    Buyer report · 29 Sep 2026 · Sample post

    Has anyone received their order from this page? Three weeks now.

    Reply from the business

    We had a delay at the port. Every order from September has now shipped, and we refunded two buyers.

    Fair to both sides

    We never delete a buyer’s post for a vendor, and we never charge for replies. Buyers see both and decide.

    Owner only

    Review before it goes live

    Reports and vendor replies wait here. Nothing shows in results until you approve it. Only you and editors can see this screen.
